name: frontend-devkit
description: A domain-neutral core for software work in any repository - feature lifecycle, bug fixing in any layer, review, commit and MR text - plus framework packs for frontend work (Vue, Nuxt). Every project fact is read from the files a repository already maintains; no component carries a fact about an individual repository.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Domain-neutral, for any repository: a feature lifecycle with automatic review, bug investigation and fixing in any layer, branch syncing, commit/MR authoring and repo preparation, plus browser verification for UI work. Install in every repository.

plugins.name: vue
plugins.description: Vue 3 / Vite SPA engineering and review knowledge: reactivity, composables, Vue Router, client vs server state, build-time config and secrets, testing. Version-gated against the installed Vue, Router, Pinia, Vite and TypeScript. Contains no repo-specific facts. Requires core.

plugins.name: nuxt
plugins.description: Nuxt SSR engineering and review knowledge: per-request state with useState instead of module scope, useFetch and useAsyncData, runtimeConfig public versus private, hydration mismatches, Nitro server routes and route middleware. A delta on the vue pack -- only what server rendering inverts or adds. Contains no repo-specific facts. Requires core and vue.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend engineering and review knowledge for Vue 3, Nuxt and Next.js: one router skill selects a framework's rules per workspace from its package.json and loads only that set. Version-gated. Contains no repo-specific facts. Depends on no other plugin.
